definitions.physics_steps: actual native 2 ms integrator calls; control intervals can have a partial terminal step
definitions.goal_ratio: (final hinge - start hinge)/(command - start hinge), degrees, no clipping
definitions.joint_error: J1..J6 post-step measured angle against held physical servo target on that substep; normalize each RMSE by the full allowed joint range
definitions.door_contact: independent judge's any door-robot contact above threshold; inspect bilateral_steps and unexpected_contact_steps separately
definitions.events: [ordered judge event, absolute 2 ms step]; recovery reports newly reached events and subtracts inherited contact steps
definitions.recovery: teacher-controlled continuation from a student snapshot; horizon completion describes 32 physical intervals; full-task denominator empty
definitions.eligible_bc_labels: query-qualified labels independently of successor duration; labels_with_complete_successor counts their intersection with legal 20 ms intervals; fitting uses training partitions only
definitions.student_steps_with_distinct_qualified_ex: student-executed decision whose qualified clipped expert target differs from the issued action by over 0.0001 normalized units on at least one channel
definitions.fresh_exposures: recorded exposure at or after segment start; a recovery can carry its previous image
definitions.success_gain: percentage-point difference in the same branch-paired frame0 test; order supervised_aggregate, model_trajectory
definitions.wall: sum of actual per-case wall times in concurrently executing workers; excludes process start/some I/O and is not elapsed job time
